patch_summary: Bound the BDC aggregate/header filter so hierarchy rows with an explicit leaf marker of either Investment Type or Instrument, plus loan/equity terms and rate or maturity evidence, are not classified as aggregate rows. This fixes BlackRock Private Credit Fund rows such as Debt Investments ... Kaman Corporation Instrument First Lien Term Loan ... Maturity while preserving category/header filtering for rows that merely contain the word Instrument without leaf economics.
primary_justification: The bundle evidence shows these are real current-period position rows, not aggregate/header rows: source-only blocker rows carry issuer, instrument, rate, maturity, and fair-value facts; HTML coordinate candidates classify sampled rows as POSITION_ROW with table coordinates; and the failure mechanism is specifically a terminal-percentage leaf parser mismatch. The production defect is the aggregate guard only recognized Investment Type leaf markers, while this filer uses Instrument.
residual_risk: The patch broadens the leaf-detail exception, so the main residual risk is accidentally retaining a category row that contains the word Instrument. The false-positive test keeps a bare Debt Investments Aerospace & Defense Instrument row classified as aggregate, and the guard still requires instrument terms plus rate or maturity evidence.
